name: com.evernote.android.job.patched.internal.v14.PlatformAlarmServiceExact
description: The patched Evernote Android Job library bundled with Yandex MapKit starts this Service when an exact-time alarm fires and runs the scheduled task; MapKit uses the same job library for offline-map downloads.
disableEffect: Exact-time background tasks scheduled through this service will not run, so app features that rely on them may stop.
